A 36-year-old car washer, Adah Martins Pius, has been sentenced to seven years’ imprisonment for stealing a customer’s Lexus 330 SUV entrusted to him for washing in Enugu State. Pius, a native of Ugep in the Yakurr Local Government Area of Cross River State, allegedly absconded with the black SUV on November 5, 2026, instead of washing and returning it to its owner. The Enugu State Police Public Relations Officer, SP Daniel Ndukwe, disclosed this in a statement issued late Monday, a copy of which was made available to our correspondent on Tuesday. Ndukwe said the incident occurred at Fourth Dimension, Enugu, adding that the suspect fled to his hometown in Cross River State with the vehicle. He said operatives of the New Haven Police Division, acting on a complaint by the vehicle owner, deployed technical intelligence to track and arrest the suspect in Cross River State. He said Pius pleaded guilty to the charge and was convicted and sentenced to seven years’ imprisonment by the court. The police command commended the operatives for their diligence in recovering the vehicle and arresting the suspect, as well as the court for the speedy dispensation of justice. It reaffirmed its commitment to combating crime and protecting lives and property across the state. Raphael Ede
